title: TAPES: Terminal Adjoint-Propagated Error Scheduling for Financial Diffusion Samplers
abstract: arXiv:2611.16484v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Financial diffusion samplers are often reused with a small number of function evaluations (NFE) inside scenario and risk pipelines, where numerical time-grid error can distort terminal quantities such as covariances, tails, and drawdown proxies. We study offline grid construction for a frozen probability-flow ODE: the score network, conditioning, Euler solver, report normalization, and deployment NFE remain fixed. TAPES (Terminal Adjoint-Propagated Error Scheduling) estimates signed local defects by Richardson comparisons, transports them through the remaining discrete flow and a terminal-report adjoint, and optimizes the squared norm of their sum before a capped direct refinement. We show that this transported signed sum is the first-order terminal-report error and quantify, under an aligned-defect model, the inefficiency of diagonal criteria. Across six budgets on a regime-switching simulation and chronologically held-out Mag

translated_title: TAPES：面向金融扩散采样器的终端伴随传播误差调度
translated_abstract: 金融扩散采样器通常在情景生成与风险流水线中被复用，且仅使用少量函数评估次数（NFE），此时数值时间网格误差可能扭曲协方差、尾部特征和回撤代理指标等终端量。我们针对一个冻结的概率流常微分方程（ODE）研究离线网格构建：得分网络、条件设置、Euler 求解器、报告归一化以及部署时的 NFE 均保持固定。TAPES（终端伴随传播误差调度）通过 Richardson 比较估计带符号的局部缺陷，将其通过剩余的离散流和终端报告伴随系统进行传播，并在设有上限的直接细化之前优化其总和的平方范数。我们证明该传播后的带符号总和即为低于二阶的终端报告误差，并在对齐缺陷模型下量化了对角准则的低效性。在状态切换模拟以及按时间顺序留出的 Mag……（摘要在此处被截断）上的六个预算下……
tldr: 该论文提出TAPES方法，通过Richardson比较估计带符号局部误差并借助终端报告伴随系统将其传播到报告终点，从而在冻结的概率流ODE下离线优化时间网格，显著降低低NFE金融扩散采样器的终端统计量（如协方差、尾部与回撤代理）误差。
en_tdlr: TAPES estimates signed local defects via Richardson comparisons and propagates them through a terminal-report adjoint to optimize offline time grids for frozen probability-flow ODEs, minimizing terminal-report errors such as covariances, tails, and drawdown proxies in low-NFE financial diffusion samplers.
